description.value: The Cowichan (Duncan) branch of Vancouver Island Regional Library traces its roots to a lending library in the late 1800s, surviving multiple relocations across Duncan before settling at its current James Street location. Part of the Vancouver Island Regional Library system serving communities across Vancouver Island and the BC coast, it offers public library services, meeting rooms, digital resources, and a range of community programming. As a free public facility in the heart of Duncan, it functions as a central community hub within easy reach of the Cowichan Valley's cycling routes.
